name: In Her Riptide's Embrace
source:
While on an HR-mandated "vacation," a burnt out office worker comes across an injured mermaid. She attempts to rescue the mermaid, only to learn that some wounds are far deeper than physical.

[From [url=https://sbriggs.itch.io/riptides-embrace]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在人力资源部规定的“假期”中，一名精疲力尽的办公室职员遇到了一条受伤的美人鱼。她试图营救美人鱼，却发现有些伤口比身体上的伤口更深。

[来自[url=https://sbriggs.itch.io/riptides-embrace]itch.io[/url]]
